You can make out an opened fridge. The fridge contains an orange bell pepper, a red hot pepper and a white onion. You see an oven. I mean, just wow! Isn't TextWorld just the best? The oven is empty! What a waste of a day! You can make out a table. The table is massive. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the table. You see a counter. The counter is vast. On the counter you can see a raw red potato and a cookbook. I mean, just wow! Isn't TextWorld just the best? You see a stove. Looks like someone's already been here and taken everything off it, though. Hm. Oh well



There is a diced fried red onion on the floor.
